title: Better Sampler Reactive 2
description: Reactive with a left sidebar of folding sections (Engine detail, Mod Sources / Matrix, Filter, Voice / Out) beside a sample viewer as wide as Better Sampler's with the engine strip fixed under it, Ableton Wavetable-style envelope / LFO / Matrix / MIDI / MPE modulation section, and a filter display that shows each voice's applied cutoff.
